feat(camellia): add universal material library routes

Summary:
- add parameterized universal material routes for font, icon, border,
  element, and seal pages plus hidden group/item/manage paths
- introduce a shared material-library UI module for list, form, upload,
  preview, and delete-confirm experiences
- wire sidebar entries through permission-aware navigation metadata for
  the migrated material domains

Rationale:
- deliver the DAM-23 frontend migration scope without spreading nearly
  identical page shells across five separate route trees
- keep hidden operational pages available for direct links while leaving
  the main menu focused on the primary library entries

Tests:
- pnpm --dir bougainvillea install --frozen-lockfile
- pnpm --dir bougainvillea typecheck:camellia
- pnpm --dir bougainvillea build:camellia
- local react-router-serve smoke for universal list/detail/group/manage
  routes
